projectDescription: MyLights is a self-hosted local media browser for managing, searching, and playing video, image, and audio files, built with Next.js and a PHP/MySQL backend.
keyFeatures: Media grid with support for images, videos, and audio files
Real-time global search across titles, descriptions, and categories
Automatic video thumbnail generation via browser-side frame extraction
Category-based filtering with hierarchical category signatures
Watch history tracking (last 50 items) in localStorage
Database statistics dashboard (total media, size, by-type counts)
One-command deployment scripts for Windows (PowerShell) and Linux/macOS (bash)
publicApiSurface: GET /backend/api/search.php?query=&type= — search media by text and/or type
searchMedia(query, type): Promise<MediaItem[]> — frontend API client
getStats(): Promise<StatsData | null> — frontend stats fetcher
MediaItem interface — id, title, description, type, signature, url, thumbnail, duration, uploadDate
StatsData interface — total_media, total_size_mb, avg_size_kb, by_type, latest_upload
